title.narrative: Model Law for Sustainable Soil Management in Africa
Modellgesetz für nachhaltige Bodenbewirtschaftung in Afrika

description.narrative: Based on the results of the project Mapping out options for a model legislation on sustainable soil management in Africa? (the ?predecessor project?) is intended to create a model law for sustainable soil management, which the Pan-African Parliament (PAP) adopted and submitted as a proposal to all national parliaments of the African Union .

Basierend auf den Ergebnissen des Projekts -Mapping out options for a model legislation on sustainable soil management in Africa- (das ?Vorgängerprojekt) soll ein Modellgesetz für ?sustainable soil management? erarbeitet werden, das vom Pan-African Parliament (PAP) angenommen und als Vorschlag an alle nationalen Parlamente der African Union übermittelt werden soll.
